heading: Four trades, one crew.
subtext: Handyman, electrical, light remodel, and exterior — all run by the same team of eight people. One number to call, one written quote, one supervisor on-site. Most homes need work in more than one of these every year, and we'd rather you didn't manage four contractors.

cards.title: Handyman Services
cards.body: Drywall, doors, fixture installs, mounting, punch-list days. $95/hr (1-hr min) or $85/hr in 4-hour blocks. Most jobs scheduled within 1–2 weeks.

cards.title: Electrical
cards.body: Outlets, fans, lighting, panel work, EV chargers. Licensed Kansas electrical contractor on every job. Flat-rate small jobs ($185 outlet, $295 fan) and free on-site quotes for bigger work.

cards.title: Light Remodel
cards.body: Kitchens, baths, and basement finish-outs in the $5k–$60k range. Free in-home estimate, written scope and price, on-site supervisor every workday, 1-year warranty.

cards.title: Exterior Services
cards.body: Deck and fence repair, gutter clean and repair, light siding fixes, exterior trim and paint. The outside punch list most homes need every couple of years.
